packageRules.description: Preset 10 pulls @conventional-changelog/template >= 1.4.0, which plants a tripwire template that throws unless the resolved conventional-changelog-writer is 9 or newer. No released @semantic-release/release-notes-generator depends on one (14.1.1 pins writer ^8), so the whole 10 line breaks the release job at generateNotes and no tag is cut. Not a version ceiling: scripts/changelog-preset.test.mjs fails the merge request that introduces an incompatible pairing, so this bump becomes mergeable on its own once release-notes-generator ships a writer 9. Approval keeps it off the merge-request queue until then rather than reopening a failing branch every run.
